packages.name: pg
packages.ownedCapability: Server-only PostgreSQL protocol client for Supabase transaction-pooler function calls
packages.nativeAlternativeRationale: Node.js has no native PostgreSQL wire client; direct function-only database access avoids browser Data API and service_role bypasses
packages.removalAndRollback: Remove after disabling runtime persistence and deleting the Vercel database secret; no schema rollback required

packages.name: @shopify/shopify-api
packages.ownedCapability: Official Shopify Session reconstruction for encrypted custom SessionStorage
packages.nativeAlternativeRationale: The official React Router authentication package requires the official Session class; Node has no Shopify-compatible native session type
packages.removalAndRollback: Remove only with Shopify React Router authentication replacement
